source.title: Effect of Empagliflozin on Heart Failure Outcomes After Acute Myocardial Infarction: Insights From the EMPACT-MI Trial
source.source_type: peer-reviewed original research article reporting prespecified and exploratory HF analyses from a randomized trial

source_packet.role: Circulation on the Run podcast transcript, interpretive context only

batch_plan.scope: source identity, design, population, eligibility, intervention, follow-up
primary hierarchy, first/recurrent HHF, timing and sensitivity analyses
exploratory HF adverse events and post-discharge therapy initiation
subgroups, limitations, conclusions, funding, conflicts and data availability

figures.content: time to first HF AE or all-cause death and total HHF
major HF outcomes and broad HHF sensitivity definitions
new HF therapy initiation through 6 months

tables: Supplementary Table 1: prespecification of outcomes and analyses
Supplementary Table 3: HF adverse-event preferred terms
Supplementary Table 4: HF adverse-event seriousness criteria
figures: Supplementary Figure 1: HF endpoint methodology and data collection
Supplementary Figure 3: major HF and mortality outcomes I
Supplementary Figure 4: major HF and mortality outcomes II
Supplementary Figure 5: HF adverse events I
Supplementary Figure 6: HF adverse events II
supplement_coverage.status: all listed tables and figures reconciled

podcast_transcript.status: reviewed as supporting interpretive context, not atomized as primary evidence
podcast_transcript.reason: The transcript restates the study and contains conversational simplifications. Formal article and supplement take precedence for trial methods and results.

omissions: The bibliography was extracted separately and not atomized.
Author affiliations were not atomized because they do not change the clinical evidence.
The podcast's summaries of unrelated articles in the same Circulation issue were outside the EMPACT-MI evidence scope.
